text:
clare: quick problem — trying to publish sdk-js for the sample app and regendiff blocked the job. It flagged a minor because examples in generated types changed key order only.

lee: can you paste the small diff?

clare: snippet from regendiff: - examples:
-   - value: {
-     "name": "greet",
-     "prompt": "hi"
-   }
+ examples:
+   - value: {
+     "prompt": "hi",
+     "name": "greet"
+   }

dev-tools-bot: Automated: regen diff in packages/sdk-js/src/generated/Examples.ts. Classified as docs/examples; semver-impact: minor (per file-change lens).

lee: that's the json-stable stringify change in typegen. Typegen now sorts object keys which reshuffled example objects. No actual API/type changes.

amy: we hit this last quarter too. Two paths: (1) quick manual override to allow publish (needs release approver), or (2) small dev-tools patch to canonicalize example objects before diffing so ordering diffs are ignored.

clare: I'm going to open a tiny PR that normalizes example objects in dev-tools regendiff comparator. If someone can review fast we can re-run CI.

lee: pushing a small helper now: dev-tools/regendiff/canonicalizeExamples.ts — it parses generated files and sorts keys only for comparison. I'll add tests for nested maps.

dev-tools-bot: New PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/dev-tools/pull/219 — adds canonicalization and a marker comment `// regendiff: ignore-example-order` to opt-in.

amy: I approved the emergency override in the release UI while we wait for regendiff fix. publish pipeline re-run queued.

dev-tools-bot: CI re-run: publish pipeline #924 — regendiff now reports "examples-order only ignored". No semver bump.

clare: publish completed successfully. Follow-ups: (1) land canonicalization PR and backfill other language SDKs, (2) add a note in the release playbook about example-order churn, (3) align typegen stringify behavior with dev-tools.

lee: filed follow-up issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/dev-tools/issues/140 — expand canonicalization to example arrays and preserve explicit ordering when annotated.

amy: thanks everyone. low-friction publishes :) :tada:
